Name: Qi's Pumpkin Spice
Author: tiakall
Description:
Happy Pumpkin Spice season y'all!

This mod replaces Qi Seasoning with a far superior blend of spices that can be used on any food, the Pumpkin Spice.  Aside from making your save file smell like fall, it functions the same as before.  For those who need a more reliable hookup than Ginger Island, there is also [s]an STF addon[/s] Gus will sell you some for 5000 gold apiece (this is the [i]good[/i] stuff.)  If you're nice to him, he might stock more for you....

Also includes a letter and dialogue from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643?tab=user+files]CopperSun[/url] so the vanilla characters (and a few secret custom NPCs >_>) can share their thoughts about pumpkin spice.

Now updated for 1.6 compatibility with new art! (thanks [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108124018]Hime[/url]!)

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/95265773?tab=user+files]skellady[/url] for testing, screenshots and suggestions, and CopperSun for encouraging my troll brain.  Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113684493]EnderTedi[/url] for helping debug my 1.6 conversion!

Downloads.Description: To install, unzip into your Mods folder.
